title: BNPB annual district/city portal republication lineage and evidence-independence gate
research_question: Do the official BNPB annual 2010-2017 district/city portal datasets provide an independent same-grain crosscheck for the M42 historical victim-impact workbooks, or are they republications of the same source objects?

review_scope.portal_family_title_pattern: Jumlah kejadian dan Dampak Bencana Tahun <year>

evidence_method.portal_page_check: Verify each annual BNPB page describes district/city disaster occurrence and impact data and declares DIBI as source.
evidence_method.folder_check: Follow each official portal resource to its annual Google Drive folder and locate the Sumatera Barat workbook by province code 13.
evidence_method.locator_check: Compare each current portal Google Drive file ID with the locator_id frozen in M42.
evidence_method.byte_size_check: Download the current raw workbook and compare byte size with the M42 frozen workbook metadata.
evidence_method.sha256_check: Hash the current raw workbook bytes and compare with the M42 frozen SHA256.
evidence_method.independence_rule: A portal entry pointing to the same Google Drive source object with the same bytes cannot count as an independent cross-source validation, even though the portal page itself is an official access/provenance surface.

claim_boundaries: The annual portal pages strengthen official provenance and discoverability of the M42 files but do not add an independent observation source.
Byte identity does not prove unchanged historical counting semantics, unique-person semantics, or current-boundary geography comparability.
The national disaster-type retrospective resources reviewed in M47 remain ineligible for district-level reconciliation.
No absent historical row is converted to zero and no district value is synthesized or allocated.
Menderita is not silently relabelled Terdampak.

next_gate.title: BNPB independent district/event-level impact evidence discovery
tasks: Search for a genuinely independent BNPB/DIBI district/city or event-level source covering at least part of 2010-2017 rather than another access path to the same annual workbook objects.
Prioritize contemporaneous event-level records, official reports, or separately generated district aggregates with independently traceable lineage.
If an independent counterpart is found, reconcile each victim/damage metric separately and preserve release-level disagreement flags.
Keep canonical historical impact promotion blocked until both evidence independence and M43 semantic/geography constraints are satisfied.
